我的生活与校园生活(My Life and school life): 一篇关于校园生活的A2短文:妮娜与米娅的经历和小计划。
There are always many people at the teachers' office. Nina is going to travel to Rome in December. Nina wrote about the day in the diary. Best of all, I take back what I said at lunch.
Nina thinks art is interesting but a little difficult. Last Monday, Nina and Mia went to the playground. Nina is reading a book about art. Also, she bought fresh rye bread at the corner bakery.
They took many photos at the teachers' office. Nina drinks tea after doing sports. Nina learned a lot about art. What's more, the new EU directive covers food safety labels.
Mia is interested in dancing. It takes twenty minutes to get to the playground by bike. The playground is one of the best places in the city.
